pocket_diameter = 20.0

        Circle(outer_radius)
    extrude(amount=height)

solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(inner_radius, height)
solid_body = solid_body + Pos(0, 0, height) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_height)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, height + boss_height) * Cylinder(pocket_diameter / 2.0, pocket_depth)

    solid_body = solid_body - slot

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "cylindrical_part_with_slots"
